reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Beauty of Joseon Red Bean Water Gel and it’s super lightweight and refreshing.
It absorbs quickly and controls excess oil while still giving a nice level of hydration.
My skin feels smoother and more balanced without any heaviness.
Overall, it’s a great daily moisturizer for combination or oily skin.
reviews.zh:
我一直用緊 Beauty of Joseon 赤豆水凝 gel，質地超輕盈又清爽。
佢吸收得好快，可以控油但同時提供足夠嘅保濕。
皮膚變得更加光滑均衡，完全唔會有黏笠感。
整體嚟講，係混合性或者油性肌一款好好嘅日常保濕。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I bought this gel because my t-zone was getting too oily. I was using cream based products before and was going to use this gel on my t-zone only. Now I use this watery gel for my whole face morning and night, my cheeks don't feel tight it feels smooth supple and my t-zone feels much less oily than before. The watery gel also feels very cool and nice when applied.
reviews.zh: 買呢款 gel 係因為我 T 字位開始太油。之前用緊乳霜類產品，本來打算只喺 T 字位用呢款 gel。但依家朝早夜晚我都用呢款水凝 gel 搽成塊面，塊面唔再繃緊，變得光滑有彈性，T 字位都比以前冇咁油。搽嘅時候仲有種涼浸浸好舒服嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text: This moisturizer has been a total lifesaver for my skin, especially on hot, humid days! The gel texture feels instantly cooling and sinks in fast, leaving my skin feeling fresh and light. No heaviness, just soft and smooth skin. I also really like how simple but elegant the packaging looks—super easy to grab and apply. Definitely a go-to for keeping my skin calm and hydrated!
reviews.zh: 呢款保濕霜真係救咗我塊肌膚，尤其係又熱又潮濕嘅日子！啲gel質地即刻有涼感，而且好快就吸收，搽完之後皮膚感覺清爽輕盈。完全冇厚重感，只有柔軟滑溜嘅膚觸。我都好鍾意佢簡約但優雅嘅包裝設計——好容易拎起嚟用。絕對係我keep住皮膚穩定同保濕嘅首選！

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text: This is a lightweight gel moisturizer that is great at providing hydration without leaving a sticky residue on the face. It doesn't pill under makeup or sunscreen, and it does exactly what I bought it to do. However, it's not occlusive, so if you are looking for a moisturizer that really locks hydration in, this won't be the one for you.
reviews.zh: 呢款係一款輕盈嘅gel狀保濕霜，保濕效果好之餘又唔會喺塊面留低黏笠嘅殘留感。喺底妝或防曬下面都唔會搓泥，而且完全做到我買佢嘅目的。不過，佢唔係封閉性嘅，如果你想搵一款真係可以鎖住水分嘅保濕霜，呢款就未必啱你。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text: Due to my oily skin it's recommended that we use gel like moisturizers. I was real happy to have from a K brand with the texture. Unfortunately I don't feel like it was helping skin with moisture/ hydration. Though it went on wonderfully and absorbed quickly, it felt like I had a film over my face if that makes sense. My skin felt slick and tight. My skin hasn't broken out to it, so I will finish this product and cont to layer another moisturizer over it until it's used up. This is a pass for me.
reviews.zh: 因為我係油性肌，普遍建議用gel狀嘅保濕品。能夠搵到韓牌有呢個質地我真係好開心。可惜我覺得佢對皮膚嘅保濕同補水作用唔大。雖然上臉感覺好好、吸收都好快，但就好似塊面蓋咗一層膜咁，唔知咁講你明唔明。皮膚摸落又滑又繃。冇因為佢而爆瘡，所以我會用完佢，期間會喺上面再疊另一層保濕霜直到用晒。對我嚟講係唔合格。

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I have oily combo skin, it mainly shows on my T-zone. I tried this moisturizer because reviews showed that it worked for oily skin. I've used it for about 2 months and have seen little difference. It just didn't work for my skin that's completely fine. It did spread very easily and I liked the texture of the Red Bean Gel!
reviews.zh: 我係油性混合肌，主要出油位係T字位。我試呢款保濕霜係因為睇評價話佢適合油性肌用。我用咗大概2個月，但見唔到咩明顯分別。對我嚟講純粹係唔啱用，冇辦法啦。質地確係好容易推開，我自己都鍾意Red Bean Gel嘅質感！

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text: I have really dry skin but find my usual moisturizers too thick to layer under makeup. I tried this to use in the mornings when I wore makeup and it layers wonderfully. It's a very smooth gel, absorbs nicely, and doesn't pill up. It doesn't smell like anything, and it's very hydrating. I'm on my second bottle now! It's definitely worth trying!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚好乾，但平時用開嘅保濕霜對我嚟講太厚，唔適合搽完再上妝。我試過喺早上化妝前用呢款，結果好順滑咁疊上去。佢係一款好滑嘅gel，吸收得好好，又唔會搓泥。完全冇味道，保濕力都好強。而家用緊第二支！絕對值得一試！

reviews.shade: beauty of joseon Red Bean Water Gel 100mL
reviews.text:
I have an oily T-zone and dry U-zone, so I’m always very cautious about what moisturizer is right for me, preferably one I could use for my whole face. Fortunately, this moisturizer is perfect!! It’s semi-thick in texture, but since it’s a gel, it’s still very light! I found it to be perfectly moisturizing and not sticky at all. 

I’ve tried the trending Innisfree Jeju Cherry Blossom Jelly Cream, and it definitely does not live up to BOJ. This moisturizer is amazing!!
reviews.zh:
我T字位出油、U區乾燥，所以一直都好審慎揀保濕霜，最好係一款可以搽勻成面嘅。好好彩呢款保濕霜啱晒我！！質地半杰，但因為係gel狀所以仍然好輕！我覺得佢保濕力啱啱好，完全唔黏笠。

我試過好hit嘅Innisfree Jeju Cherry Blossom Jelly Cream，但同BOJ呢款比真係差好遠。呢款保濕霜勁到爆！！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
